name: Turbo Dash
description: An endless runner platformer where a turquoise character auto-runs through a colorful world, leaping over gaps, dodging spikes, and collecting golden coins. How far can you go?
author: CaisoGames AI Team

touch.description: Tap to jump, hold for a higher jump

features: 4-frame run cycle animation with a bouncy vertical bob
Variable jump height - hold the key to jump higher
Procedural platform generation with guaranteed-jumpable gaps
Four-layer parallax background (sky, clouds, hills, foreground grass)
Golden coins with a 4-frame 3D spin animation
Spike obstacles placed past a safe landing zone
Difficulty scaling: speed, gap size and obstacle rate grow with distance
Distance-based scoring with a session best

unique: Variable jump height, so the same button covers short hops and long leaps
Speed rises every 500 points up to a 10 px/frame cap

tiers.name: Easy Start
tiers.description: Wide platforms, small gaps, no spikes

tiers.name: Getting Going
tiers.description: Narrower platforms, medium gaps, occasional spikes

tiers.name: Full Speed
tiers.description: Bigger gaps, more floating platforms, frequent spikes
